types.name: Config
docs: Protocol configuration PDA.
Stores the active Oracle identity and SRC Mint address
for the current protocol session.
This is NOT a registry — it stores the *working pair*
(oracle + mint) that the protocol uses at any given time.
The full set of trusted oracles lives in OracleRegistry.
Single Responsibility:
Config = active oracle + mint binding
Vault   = protocol economics
OracleRegistry = set of trusted oracles

types.name: PolicyRegistry
docs: Policy Registry (ADR-0003).
On-chain set of policies that determine which Proofs and mints are allowed.
`mint_energy` (Verifier) **does not make decisions** — it executes the
policies addressed by this registry. This removes the documented
"verifier+policy co-location" deviation (see `instructions/mint.rs`).
PDA: seeds = [b"policy-registry"]
**Backward compatibility:** the account is optional in `MintEnergy`. If the
PDA is not initialized, the protocol default policies apply — behavior
identical to the pre-Policy Engine version. After initialization, policies
are set via `update_policy` (registry authority; may later be handed over
to Governance ADR-0009 via `set_policy_authority`).

Reputation PDA for a producer (owner). Takes into account:
- uptime without failures,
- volume of verified energy,
- absence of generation profile anomalies (penalties via `report_anomaly`).
A high ERS provides an advantage in pool reward distribution
(share weighting, see pool.rs) and access to premium features of
ENRG Market (v7.0 §16, §30) — `ers_premium_eligible`.

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Time of the last update.

fields.name: total_energy_wh
docs: Total verified energy (Wh) — contribution to the score.

fields.name: first_seen
docs: First appearance (unix ts) — basis for uptime calculation.

fields.name: anomaly_count
docs: Number of recorded profile anomalies (v7.0 §27).

fields.name: percentile
docs: Approximate network percentile (0..=100; on-chain approximation).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the PDA.

types.name: ReputationUpdated
docs: Emitted after ERS is refreshed by a mint (v7.0 §16).

types.name: RewardDistributed
docs: Emitted after rewards have been distributed.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the stake.

fields.name: staked_amount
docs: Amount currently staked.

fields.name: pending_rewards
docs: Pending rewards.

fields.name: started_at
docs: Stake creation timestamp.

fields.name: last_update
docs: Last rewards update.

types.name: TokenMint
docs: SPL Token configuration.
Stores the protocol mint configuration and
all protocol-owned token accounts.

fields.name: mint
docs: SRC Mint.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: PDA allowed to mint SRC.

fields.name: buyback_account
docs: Buyback fund ATA.

fields.name: staking_account
docs: Staking rewards ATA.

fields.name: dao_account
docs: DAO treasury ATA.

fields.name: emergency_account
docs: Emergency reserve ATA.

fields.name: founder_account
docs: Founder ATA — where founder tokens are minted at launch (premine).

fields.name: founder_minted
docs: One-shot flag: 1 after the founder premine (repeat forbidden).

fields.name: decimals
docs: Token decimals.

fields.name: mint_bump
docs: SRC Mint PDA bump.

fields.name: mint_authority_bump
docs: Mint Authority PDA bump.

fields.name: buyback_authority_bump
docs: Buyback Authority PDA bump.

fields.name: bump
docs: TokenMint PDA bump.

types.name: TokensBurned
docs: Emitted after tokens are burned from the buyback fund.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount of SRC burned.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Remaining balance in buyback fund.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: New total supply after burn.

fields.name: initiator
docs: Initiator of the burn (Vault.authority — governor).

types.name: Vault
docs: Global protocol state.
Vault stores protocol economics,
emission state and global statistics.
SPL mint configuration is maintained
separately by the TokenMint PDA.

fields.name: deployer
docs: Wallet that deployed the protocol.

fields.name: authority
docs: Current protocol authority.

fields.name: protocol_version
docs: Protocol version.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Total SRC minted.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Maximum SRC supply.

fields.name: emission_k
docs: Current emission coefficient.

fields.name: total_energy_wh
docs: Total verified energy (Wh).

fields.name: total_producers
docs: Total registered producers.

fields.name: total_proofs
docs: Total accepted proofs.

fields.name: network_energy_30d
docs: Sum of all device energy for last 30 days (Wh).
Used for dynamic difficulty calculation.

fields.name: network_energy_updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last network energy update.

types.name: VaultAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted when the vault authority changes (single-step; multisig/timelock planned).
